newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yamaha retreats after hitting record high in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Yamaha retreats after hitting record high in Tokyo.

text.p: Shares in Yamaha Corp retreated slightly after jumping to a lifetime high of 2,520 in Tokyo afternoon trade on Thursday, brokers said.
As of 0552 GMT, the shares were up 160 yen at 2,470 after rising briefly to a high of 2,520, above the previous record high of 2,500 yen marked in March 1985.

Buying was encouraged partly by bright earnings prospects for the company as well as early morning news that Daiwa Institute of Research Ltd has assigned the maker of musical instruments an "A" rating, brokers said.

In its three-grade rating system, the research institute assigns an "A" rating to issues whose values it sees outperforming the Tokyo Stock Exchange"s first-section TOPIX index by more than 10 percentage points over the next six months.
